title: swing43: RSI(2) pullback in a long-term uptrend (Connors-style), held for days, 8 equity indices primary, 33 daily markets
before_registration: Only synthetic fixtures (swing43.py check) and trade counts per window/group/variant (swing43.py describe; entry and exit bars are computed but no return, drift or excess is computed or printed) ran. Prior knowledge: tsmom36 FAIL, cal37 FAIL, ext39 FAIL (indices lean to reversal in 2023+ only), vm40 FAIL. Published claim (Connors and Alvarez 2008, short-term pullbacks in an uptrend, strongest on equity indices).
data: audit/tsmom36/daily.db read-only via ext39.load() (33 OANDA daily mid series, bars close 17:00 New York, trading date = close date, weekend stubs dropped, last close 2026-10-08). Spreads: audit/tsmom36/out/spreads.json (median M1 spread from history.db candles_ba). Nothing fetched.

definitions.trend: close[t] > SMA200[t] (simple mean of the 200 closes t-199..t); no setup before 200 bars
definitions.rsi: Wilder RSI(2) on closes: seed = mean of the first 2 gains/losses, then avg = (avg + x) / 2; RSI 100 when the average loss is 0
definitions.setup: close[t] > SMA200[t] and RSI2[t] < 10, at the close of day t. Long only
definitions.entry: close of day t (17:00 New York mid)
definitions.exit: first close j > t with close[j] > SMA5[j] (mean of closes j-4..j), else close of t+10 trading bars, whichever first
definitions.one_trade: one open trade per instrument; the next entry needs a setup bar strictly after the previous exit bar. Trades without an exit bar in the data are dropped
definitions.matched_drift: mu_w = mean of daily log returns ln(c_d / c_{d-1}) over all days d in window w whose prior close c_{d-1} was above SMA200 (same instrument); matched drift of a trade = mu_w x trading bars held. This is a window-level benchmark, it is not causal
definitions.excess: trade log return minus matched drift
definitions.window: by entry date: dev 2005-01-01..2022-12-31; second 2023-01-01..2026-10-08 (development window, not a holdout)
definitions.costs: futures-style net = gross - 2 x half median spread (2 bps per side where no spread exists: HK33 and the instruments not in spreads.json). CFD net = futures-style net - 0.822 bps (3%/365) per calendar night held. Costs are reported, never decide the verdict

primary.universe: SPX500_USD, NAS100_USD, US30_USD, DE30_EUR, UK100_GBP, JP225_USD, HK33_HKD, AU200_AUD pooled, equal weight per trade
primary.ci: cluster bootstrap by ISO calendar week of the entry date, 1000 reps, seed 43, percentile 95% (ext39.week_boot)
primary.pass: pooled index mean excess > 0 with CI lower bound > 0 in BOTH windows; otherwise FAIL. One test
primary.power_ex_ante: assumed trade SD about 220 bps (1.2% daily vol, about 3-4 days held): MDE80 about 19 bps dev and 35 bps 2023+

secondary_never_decide: 2 and 3 consecutive down closes instead of RSI (with the trend filter)
short mirror: close < SMA200 and RSI2 > 90, exit at first close < SMA5 or 10 bars, drift matched on days with prior close < SMA200, financing charged on shorts too
groups: indices, commodities, FX, bonds, trading6 (WTI, XAU, XAG, NATGAS, SPX500, EUR/USD), all 33
gross mean, matched drift, futures-style and CFD net (each with CI), hit rate (gross > 0 and excess > 0), average trading days and calendar nights held, trades per year, MDE80 of the excess
multiplicity: 7 variants x 6 groups x 2 windows = 84 group cells plus per-instrument cells, all logged to trials.jsonl (exp swing43). Only the primary cell decides
confirmation: development evidence only; any survivor needs prospective confirmation (issue 313) or data after 2026-10-07
